name: Swipe-ruler balance
summary: Swipe event cards left or right to decide; four meters must all stay out of the red and out of overflow.
core_loop: read card → swipe a side → meters shift → next card → any meter at 0 or max ends the run
rules: each card has a left and a right effect on 1-3 meters
a meter at 0 or at max ends the run
some cards unlock only after earlier choices
win: survive as many years as possible

reigns but i'm the head of a high school student council
tinder for kings

name: Branching story with endings
summary: A short branching story where each scene offers two or three choices leading to distinct endings.
core_loop: read scene → pick a choice → next scene → reach an ending → see which ending you got
rules: every scene has 2-3 choices
paths can merge
endings are labeled good, bad or secret
win: reach an ending, ideally the best one
social_hooks: send a friend the ending you got
dare friends to find the secret ending
example_prompts: choose your own adventure about getting lost in a haunted mall
a branching story where i'm a dragon's accountant
interactive story about the last day of summer
gamebook with 5 endings

name: Endings collector
summary: The same short story replays with a progress book that tracks which of N endings you have found.
core_loop: play a run → hit an ending → ending ticks off the book → restart → try a different choice
rules: story is under 8 scenes
each run is 20-40 seconds
endings are named and count toward a total
social_hooks: share a Group's combined endings found
difficulty_levers: how hidden the last ones are

stanley parable but in a grocery store

name: Typed text adventure
summary: Type short commands like 'open door' to explore rooms and solve one escape goal.
core_loop: read room → type a command → world responds → find items → reach the exit
rules: a small verb list (look, take, use, go)

unknown commands get a funny reply

limited turns

failing a check has a story consequence, not a game over
